rebalance_callable_by_anyone.meaning: rebalanceFunds() can be invoked by any caller because it has no access control modifier

reentrancy_guard_absent.meaning: rebalanceFunds() lacks a nonReentrant modifier, so no reentrancy guard is active during the external custodian transfer

custodian_is_contract.meaning: the custodian address is a contract able to execute code during the external transfer callback

token_callback_enabled.meaning: the vault token is ERC777 or otherwise callback-enabled so a transfer can invoke recipient code

excess_drained_twice.meaning: the malicious custodian drains the excess amount twice via reentrancy during the external _vaultToken.transfer(custodian, excess) call

assumptions: The external transfer in rebalanceFunds() sends an excess amount to the custodian address.
The malicious custodian re-enters rebalanceFunds() during the external transfer callback.
No concrete excess amount is given; the drain-twice outcome is treated as a Boolean observable.

unresolved.description: Report does not state a concrete excess amount or vault balance, so the drain-twice magnitude cannot be quantified; only the Boolean occurrence is formalized.

limitations: Formalizes only the reentrancy drain-twice impact; access-control spam and under-collateralization impacts are handled in separate passes.
The drain-twice outcome is conditional on custodian being a contract and callback-enabled tokens, both encoded as preconditions.
